quest.title: The Shining Warriors Take the Stage
quest.description: As the white snow flutters down, you return to the foot of Dragonspine...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3, Mystic Enhancement Ore x6, The Soulblazer Saga: Volume 2 x1

chapter.title: The Shining Warriors Take the Stage

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey there, Amber!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Ah! Honorary Knight, Paimon! Sorry, I was chatting away and didn't even notice you arrive. It's so good to see you again!

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, I was just discussing competition stuff with Mr. Heinz. So what brings you to Dragonspine? Not a commission, I assume?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope, we just saw some cool flyer and thought we'd come see what all the fuss is about.

choices.text: I go where the fun is.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Well then, you've come to the right people! Mr. Heinz and I are staff on the organizing committee here.

response.speaker: Heinz
response.text: Hello, Honorary Knight. And you must be Paimon?

response.speaker: Heinz
response.text: Field Officer Heinz, 1st Company, Knights of Favonius. It's an honor to meet you both.

response.speaker: Heinz
response.text: The contest hasn't kicked off yet. We're still in the process of issuing the spectator tickets and VIP tickets.

response.speaker: Heinz
response.text: Speaking of which — take these. We reserved a couple of VIP tickets for you.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Thank you so much!

response.speaker: Heinz & Amber
response.text: You're welcome.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You mentioned an organizing committee... Is that for the Dragonspine International Cross Country Challenge? That's what we saw on the flyer.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Yep! The organizing committee's a joint effort between the Knights of Favonius and representatives from Springvale.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: More specifically, Heinz and I are in charge of registrations and security, while the Springvale team is responsible for refereeing and support.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: So any problems, just come find us! We're here to make sure all contestants and spectators have an enjoyable experience.

choices.text: We can always count on you.

response.speaker: Heinz
response.text: This is the biggest contest of its kind we've ever had. A lot of international contestants have signed up, even some from Natlan. It's sure to be an exciting few days.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, Natlan? I think I know who you mean.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: If we're thinking of the same team, there's this one contestant with pink hair and a really impressive pair of horns on her head.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Also, she has a huuuuge appetite! A lot of the staff really enjoy dining with her.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Hahaha, the way she relishes her food, it puts everyone else in the mood to eat, too.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Then there's the girl with the stripy yellow-and-black tail. It's so fluffy and cute...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Uh, but she seems super cool though. I wouldn't dare call her cute to her face...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, those definitely sound like people we know...

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Oh, no way! You know them?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Well, if you wanna find them, their team's camp is over there. Their tent has a really unique design, you can't miss it.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Honestly, it's a really cool camp in general. Plus, they brought a whole stash of comic books with them.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon sees it! We'll go check it out later. Thanks, Amber.

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Great. Oh, and when you do, any chance you could borrow one of their comic books for me?

response.speaker: Amber
response.text: Their team's always talking about the comics they read, and it's gotten me kinda curious. I would go ask them myself, but I can't really leave my post.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure, no problem. Leave it to us!

choices.text: I was hoping we might run into some old friends.

talks.objective: Go look for the familiar faces

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hello. Are Varesa and Xilonen around?
Ah, so you're looking for the captain and vice captain.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: #...{NICKNAME}? I thought I was seeing things... I can't believe it's really you!

choices.text: Alrani! How's that thesis coming along?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Don't even go there... Please, I'm supposed to be on vacation here.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: However much I want to finish my thesis, I'm only human. I've been fighting a losing battle with it recently.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Right now, I feel completely defeated by it. It's knocked me to the ground, and I'm just gonna lie here until I'm ready to get up and face it again. Until then, I'm begging you — please, please don't bring up my thesis.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wow, we've run into so many people we know already. What a small world!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Since we all know Varesa and Xilonen, that makes things a lot easier.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We heard they're taking part in the cross country contest, so we thought we'd come say hi.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: They're not here right now. But if you're not in a hurry, you're welcome to stick around the camp and wait.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sounds good. Your tents are really cool by the way... Ah, and there's that stash of comic books Amber mentioned.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, yeah. A friend of ours mentioned that. Hearing you all talk about comic books got her interested, too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Which series have you guys been reading?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Comics? So, you, too, are fellow comic book lovers? Haha! And so the truth comes to light.
"Intensity" draws "intensity"... The "strongest" will surely cross paths with the "strongest"... Thus it was written, and thus has it come to pass.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: You approach us humbly in search of the truth...

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: And I, Tang Yigang, will show you the light.

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: The series you speak of is a bible to us, the Legion of Soulblazers. And its name is... The Soulblazer Saga.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: But what is a "Soulblazer," I hear you ask? And what kind of organization is the Legion of Soulblazers?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Yigang, answer me this... What are the founding tenets of the Legion of Soulblazers?

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: Answer you I shall. Tenet the First: "If you think bitter tears and strong words are enough to broker peace, you are woefully naive!"

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: Tenet the Second: "I pledge to give my life fighting the forces of eternal darkness, even if we fight in vain!"

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: We, the Legion, swear to follow the Soulblazers even unto death! Our motto is:

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: Through pain and defeat, I shall never fear! I will always champion love and imagination!

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Also, it may interest you to know that those two tenets are actually taken directly from the series itself. Soulblazer 6: Shadow of Tenebrium.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: ...Uh... Why aren't you saying anything? Didn't that make you feel something? Like, light a fire in your heart? Not even a little spark?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Honestly? No. It was all kinda abstract... Paimon couldn't really follow.

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: This is a failure of immeasurable proportions...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: You'd better stop lighting fires in people's hearts, or you'll burn 'em to a crisp.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Vice Captain! Thank goodness you're back. Listen, we have a situation—

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: #It's okay, I don't need all that. The look on {NICKNAME} and Paimon's faces tells me everything I need to know.

choices.text: I'm completely lost. Can you explain?

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Let me guess, Alrani and Tang Yigang said a bunch of stuff, and it was all pretty baffling, right? Yeah... Just think of it as them kidding around. Like an inside joke you're not in on.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: They probably hit you with a barrage of quotes from The Soulblazer Saga, a comic book series published by the Yae Publishing House.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Also, every time you hear "Legion of Soulblazers," think "comic book fan club."

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohhhh... Okay. That clears everything up. Well, except... why did this fan club suddenly decide to meet in Mondstadt?

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Heh, well, beats me. But I'm sure they'll happily answer that question. With plenty of gratuitous passion and drama.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The usual scathing accuracy...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: I'm pretty sure Alrani doesn't even know why they're here. But, if you ask them, they'll probably say something like:

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: Because we are Soulblazers! The passion of youth is strong with us, and it demands that we heed the call to adventure! With every great trial comes great opportunity!

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: ...Yeah, something like that.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: But more to the point, though, it was one of their members, Minnie, who suggested they hold their next meeting here. The Dragonspine cross country contest, yeah, was her idea too.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: And after much consideration, they thought Minnie's suggestion was a good idea, so they went ahead with it.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: And that's how the Legion of Soulblazers and I ended up here.

choices.text: So, any chance I can borrow one of your comic books?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Absolutely! I made sure to bring a few extra copies in case we happened to run into some like-minded people.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Who's your friend? Where are they based?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: She's actually on the organizing committee. Her name's Amber, wears a red bow, bubbly personality... Does that ring a bell?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: Oh, I know who you mean! She's super friendly. I can run over a copy to her right now.

response.speaker: Tang Yigang
response.text: I'll come with.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: #Perfect. Thanks, you two. Oh, and {NICKNAME}, you still wanna say hi to Varesa? She's over at the training grounds.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Won't you come with us?

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: ...Guess my nap will have to wait then. Okay, fine, if you insist. Let's go.

choices.text: Or, can my friend come here and read them?

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: You don't remember me? ...I guess that's fair. After everything you've been through, all the people you've met, you probably don't have space in your brain for small-timers like me.

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: I'm Alrani, an aspiring herbad at the Akademiya... Technically just a driyosh in the meantime, hehe...

response.speaker: Alrani
response.text: But once I finish my graduation thesis, I'll be a herbad before long!

talks.objective: Head to the training grounds to find Varesa

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey, Varesa! We've come to watch you train, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: #Wait, was that Paimon? Paimon! {NICKNAME}! Ah, I've missed you guys so much!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You and Xilonen tell Varesa about the events of the day so far.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Ahahaha! So Alrani and Yigang were just quoting lines at you? Way to make a first impression...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Exactly! Their whole conversation was like a closed loop. Even Paimon couldn't find a way in!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: If it were me, I would have started with: "Maximum power!"

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Mmm, that doesn't exactly welcome people into the conversation either.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Especially not when they see you hoisting Minnie up into the air and spinning her around in circles the first time you all meet up. Before anyone's even said a word.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh crumbs... Yeah, now I think about it, that's pretty embarrassing...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I mean, we all kinda knew each other... but only through writing letters and trading illustrations. That was our first time meeting in person.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I just got overexcited when I recognized Minnie, hehe... Couldn't help myself.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hold on, you two traveled here together, right? So why did you say "the Legion of Soulblazers and I" when you were introducing everyone earlier?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Aren't you part of their team?

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: It's because I'm not a member of their fan club. Nepecha is. I'm sort of standing in for her.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Pretty good. She's eating, getting enough sleep, and doing well in her studies. Hooked on comic books, though. And that's where Minnie comes in — they're pen pals.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Nepecha's always telling me how amazing Minnie is. She's such a great artist, knows how to make comic book props, gives the best life advice...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Honestly, she made her sound more like a mom than a peer... So, I was pretty surprised when I got her and found out that nope, Minnie's actually pretty young.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Anyway, when Nepecha heard that Minnie had suggested a cross country contest on Dragonspine, she wanted to join in.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: But... She is in no condition for extreme sports, and well, she knows it. So instead, she asked me to go represent her at the contest and say hi to Minnie while I'm here.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Hehe, and I'd been preparing to go traveling for a while anyway, so we figured we'd team up.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Uh-huh, and before I knew it, I'd inexplicably ended up with the title of vice captain...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: W—Well, yeah! You were the obvious choice! You're clearly captain material, and... y'know the best vice captains are the ones you can turn to and say, "keep this up, I know you'll make captain one day!"

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: You could also argue that the person who is "clearly captain material" should be made captain, but hey — what would I know? ...Ugh, never mind, I refuse to get drawn into that whole discussion...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Anyway, I'm mostly here to buy souvenirs for Nepecha. Huh, it's like, Soulblazer-themed... uh...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Merch!

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Oh... Okay, "merch," I guess. Uh-huh. Basically, badges, novelty notepaper with character art, reprints of old comics, painted wooden character cutouts...

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: ...Um, what's with that look, Varesa? Did I... Did I say something wrong?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: N—No, nothing's wrong. It's just, kinda strange hearing you talk all about that merch with such a straight face...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: The thought of Xilonen, the master craftswoman, carrying boxes of merch back home to Natlan... Hehe, it's such a funny image!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That's a pretty long list, too. Did Nepecha really ask for all that!?

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Oh, no. She'd never ask other people to buy gifts for her. It's not in her nature.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: But based on what I know about her, I'm sure she'll appreciate some, uh... merch. I still prefer "souvenirs" personally, but...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Oh, definitely! Nepecha will be over the moon! Hehe, you really understand her, Xilonen. You're like her older sister.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Close enough, I mean, we are technically family. Although, we haven't known each other long, so I can't claim to understand her that well. I'm still learning.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: *panting*... Push-up... I mean, Varesa... I finished my push-ups...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That makes four sets, right? Good job! Time for a breather.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #Minnie, I'd like to introduce you to {NICKNAME} and Paimon. They're friends of me and Xilonen. We met in Natlan.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Wait... blond hair, flying companion... Are you... Mondstadt's Honorary Knight?

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Wow... I can't believe I get to meet you in person! I heard about you from my older brother. He works at the tavern, so he hears all the local gossip from the customers.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Apparently, you go from nation to nation, making a huge name for yourself each time? Like a real-life comic book hero! So. Cool.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Do you mind if I ask you a question? Of all the adventures you've had... which is the most memorable?

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Considering the present company, you elect to recount some of your experiences from Natlan.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Wow... incredible! Sounds like Fietena's homeland is just as magical as in the stories!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Ohh, you have no idea! Where I'm from, in the Collective of Plenty, we live right next to a huge volcano! And when it erupts, it sends fireballs shooting all over the place! Super dangerous, obviously, but it's the perfect place for hero training!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: You know how much I've always wanted to take a trip away from Mondstadt... Just get away and see the outside world...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You totally should! Mondstadt's supposed to be the land of freedom, right? So... what's stopping you?

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: It's just...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: If the Honorary Knight's journey is anything to go by, it sounds so daunting. Surely, you gotta be really tough to keep pressing on through so many dangers... I just don't know if I'm up to it.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: #{NICKNAME} sets a pretty high bar for toughness, that's for sure... But, y'know, we each make our own journey at our own pace!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: So stay strong, and soldier on! Just like Fietena. In moments of doubt, following her example will never lead us astray!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: You're right... Okay, I won't give up!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: If nothing else, I have to make good on the deal with my parents: train hard, and get a good race time.

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: A deal with your parents? You didn't mention that before.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Oh, uh... Yeah, well...

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You'll be fine! I do the same thing with my coach, Iansan. Before every competition, I promise her I'll get a better result than the last time.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: You can never know for sure how it'll go, but sometimes having that pressure can really help with motivation.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: That being said, you can't forget to have fun! Don't lose sight of that. It's the whole reason you organized this Dragonspine meetup in the first place!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: You're right! Still... this is a competition. Sure, I might not win, but I still wanna be proud of my result.

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Alrighty, well if you wanna kick some butt in this contest, then let's get back to training!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Sure! Watch out, Varesa, this time I'm gonna keep up with you!

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Enough. You only just finished training. Varesa, I'm sure you're still raring to go, but Minnie, you have to rest if you want to recover.

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: But I'm fine...

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: *rumbling*

response.speaker: Xilonen
response.text: Your stomach begs to differ. Sounds like it's time to eat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yup, you gotta eat hard to train hard!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: It's true, diet is an essential part of any training program! I can share Coach Iansan's special recipes with you. You'll wake up tomorrow bursting with energy, guaranteed!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: Really? What about the local food in Mondstadt, though? Any idea what would make a good post-workout meal?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I'm not too sure... But you can never go wrong by listening to your stomach!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: I think, start with a Meatnado... then move onto a Grilled Fish in Mint Sauce, a few Tatacos, some Stuffed N' Mashed Potatoes, wash it down with a Grainfruit Meat Soup, then finish it off with an Apple Roly Poly for dessert!

response.speaker: Minnie
response.text: What!? All that for one person!?

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Yup! Open your mind and stomach, relish the delicious flavors, and before you know it, you'll demolish everything!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Oh, we're almost back at the camp. After what Xilonen was saying earlier, lemme give this to you before I forget...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Here! The Soulblazer Saga, volume 2. I figured other people might wanna read it, so I made sure to bring some extra copies.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Unfortunately, it looks like I somehow forgot to pack volume 1 in my luggage... Shame. It's always best to start from the beginning when you're trying to get your friends into a new comic series...

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Anyway, take a look in your free time, see what you think... Ahhh, I really hope you like it! It would be soooo cool to have an awesome person like you in the fanbase!

response.speaker: Varesa
response.text: Alright, we're gonna meet back up with the others. Come hang out with us again soon, okay?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ugh, why'd it have to end there? Fietena and her buddies fought an amazing battle, Paimon really wants to see what happens next!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's go meet up with Varesa and her team when we get the chance. We can ask them what happens in the next volume.

choices.text: I'll take a look when I get the chance.

dialogues.speaker: Heinz
dialogues.text: We're still setting up the course. If you were hoping to take a look around, I'm afraid now's not the time.

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: You know when the contest starts, right? Don't forget to come and watch on the day!

dialogues.speaker: Amber
dialogues.text: Thanks! It'll be nice to have something to read after my shift ends.

dialogues.speaker: Alrani
dialogues.text: Don't mention it. I'm always happy to meet people who share my interests.

dialogues.speaker: Tang Yigang
dialogues.text: Ditto that.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: Varesa and Minnie are training together. They've been at it all day.

dialogues.speaker: Xilonen
dialogues.text: But, it is freezing out here, so it's time to call it.
